nodes.name: Din shuru
nodes.notes: Roz subah associate Kylas par console kholta hai. Yahin se flow shuru hota hai.

nodes.name: S1 · Accounts milte hain
nodes.notes: Kylas owner se Companies list

parameters.content:
## Step 1 · Accounts milte hain
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Company ka owner Kylas mein tay hota hai. Console poora account crawl karke cache karta hai (lagbhag 17,900 companies) aur owner se chhaanta hai.
• Focus list mein ek baar mein 250 tak accounts add hote hain.
• Bulk re-assign contacts aur account owner dono badalta hai, 50 accounts ke batch mein.

**Kya karna hai**
• Queue ka order tay karo.
• Team roster aur Kylas users milao (Charu Rathi, Gaurav Kumar roster mein nahi).
• October batch ka Source of Data tag (276 companies) Kylas mein likho.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  Queue flat hai. Connect rate par iska asar ho sakta hai.
🔴 OPEN  Roster alag chalta hai, unknown naam bhi team total mein ginte hain.
🔴 OPEN  Source of Data tag baaki hai.
🟢 DONE  Account ka owner ab bulk re-assign se badalta hai (server deploy ke baad).

nodes.name: ✔ Kaam layak accounts hain?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Console mein apne naam par accounts dikhte hain, aur unke contacts ka owner Kylas mein active user hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Inactive owner ke records
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: 13 deactivated users ke naam par contacts bache hain (KPI copy mein 24 contacts, 10 companies; asli ginti zyada ho sakti hai). Kylas inactive user ko record wapas nahi deta, isliye move one-way hai. In accounts par koi kaam nahi kar raha.

Pehla kadam:
• Console ke bulk Re-assign se live owners ko do.
• Re-assign se pehle chetavni jodo: 'ye owner inactive hai'.
• Team panel mein in naamon ko untick karo.

nodes.name: S2 · Research aur history
nodes.notes: cfRemarks, call logs, research

parameters.content:
## Step 2 · Research aur history
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Pichhle remarks Kylas ke cfRemarks field se aate hain.
• History pane contact ke Kylas call logs dikhata hai.
• Research pane read-only hai. 1280px se chaudi screen par teesra column.

**Kya karna hai**
• History mein dialler ke calls upar dikhao.
• Remarks ke saath kisne aur kab likha, ye dikhao.
• Associates ki screen size poochho (split layout 1400px maanta hai).

**Gaps**
🔴 OPEN  Console ke logs 0 second aur Enout Super Admin naam se dikhte hain.
🟡 DECISION  Screen size ki jaanch nahi hui.

nodes.name: ✔ Pichhla context dikhta hai?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Contact kholne par pichhle remarks dikhte hain, aur history mein asli calls (duration ke saath) dikhti hain.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · History adhoori ya galat
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Console se bane Kylas logs mein duration 0 aur owner API key ka user hota hai. Dialler ke asli logs alag hain. Contact ki history mein dono mil jaate hain aur associate ko pata nahi chalta kaunsi asli call thi.

Pehla kadam:
• Dialler logs ko history mein duration ke saath dikhao.
• Console ke 0s logs ko 'console save' naam se alag label do.

nodes.name: Agla din
nodes.notes: Review ke baad jo accounts, owners aur atke contacts tay hue, wahi agle din ki queue bante hain. Flow Step 1 se dobara shuru hota hai.

nodes.name: S3 · Call lagate hain
nodes.notes: Kylas dialler app

parameters.content:
## Step 3 · Call lagate hain
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Dialler app se call: Kylas asli duration, phone ka device aur associate ka naam likhta hai.
• Console ka tel: link bhi hai, par dashboard console ka stopwatch nahi padhta.
• Kylas ka call-log read sirf newest N logs deta hai. Paging, sort ya date filter nahi chalta.

**Kya karna hai**
• Tay karo: dialler app sab ke liye zaroori hai ya nahi.
• Click-to-call (telephony) par faisla.
• Dialler log ko console ke save se jodo.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  Normal phone se lagi call ki length kahin nahi.
🟡 DECISION  Click-to-call nahi, last-called-at haath se bharta hai.
🟢 DONE  Dialler Calls table ban gayi aur pehla import hua (134 calls, 110m37s).

nodes.name: ✔ Call ka log aur length mili?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Call ke kuch minute baad Kylas mein dialler ka log banta hai aur ghante ke import mein Dialler Calls table mein aa jaata hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: Kaunsi vajah? (D3)
nodes.notes: Placeholder: $json.reason mein wajah aati hai.

nodes.name: 🟡 DECISION · Call ki length nahi
nodes.notes:
🟡 DECISION
Kyun: Sirf dialler app ki call ki length Kylas mein aati hai. 1000 logs mein 134 hi timed the. Baaki calls ginti mein hain par talk time mein nahi.

Pehla kadam:
• Faisla: dialler app ko niyam banao, ya
• dashboard par 'n/m timed' hi padho (abhi yahi hota hai).

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Log window se bahar
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Kylas ka read sirf newest 1000 logs deta hai. Do runs ke beech 1000 se zyada call aayi to beech wali hamesha ke liye kho jaati hain. Is team ke volume (300 se 600 per din) par ghante ka import kaafi hai, par gap ki chetavni abhi sirf log mein dikhti hai.

Pehla kadam:
• Gap ki chetavni email digest mein bhejo.
• Kylas se webhook ya paged endpoint maango.

nodes.name: S4 · Console mein capture
nodes.notes: stage, event rows, next call

parameters.content:
## Step 4 · Console mein capture
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• 85% calls mein kam typing: no-answer, galat insaan, adhoori baat.
• Budget, timeline, pax free text hain. Right POC apne aap tay hota hai: koi ek bhara ho.
• Stage badhne par zaroori fields badhte hain aur save rokte hain.

**Kya karna hai**
• Pipeline Stage, Source of Data, Offsite Timeline, Salutation ki picklists Kylas se confirm karo.
• Offsite Timeline mein ek se zyada quarter (REQ-04).
• Double-save ki jaanch.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  Picklists andaaze se hain.
🔴 OPEN  Offsite Timeline sirf ek quarter rakhta hai.
🔴 OPEN  Anjali Athya ke contacts par 19 second mein lagbhag 24 saves dikhe.

nodes.name: ✔ Save ke liye taiyaar?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Zaroori fields bhare hain, owner chuna hai, aur ek call ke liye ek hi save hua hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: Kaunsi vajah? (D4)
nodes.notes: Placeholder: $json.reason mein wajah aati hai.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Save ruk gaya
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Naye contact par Owner dropdown tab tak khaali rehta hai jab tak Kylas se owner list nahi aati, aur save 'Still needed: Owner' par ruk jaata hai.

Pehla kadam:
• Ab console turant batata hai (ho chuka).
• Owner list console khulte hi pehle load karo.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Ek call, kai saves
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Calls dialled har save ko ek call ginta hai. Anjali Athya ke contacts par 19 second mein lagbhag 24 saves dikhe. Double-click, auto-save ya retry se number phool sakta hai.

Pehla kadam:
• Save logs dekhkar karan pata karo.
• Ek contact par 60 second ke andar dobara save ho to chetavni ya merge.

nodes.name: S5 · Save
nodes.notes: Worker se Kylas aur Airtable

parameters.content:
## Step 5 · Save
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Worker turant jawab deta hai, save D1 queue mein rehta hai.
• Kylas contact: poora record padhkar ek field badalkar PUT.
• Kylas call log, aur Airtable ke Contacts, Event Rows, Call Log, Stage Transitions.
• Dono taraf lagbhag 5 requests per second ki limit.

**Kya karna hai**
• Console ke logs ka owner (Super Admin) kaise badle, ye tay karo.
• Associate ko saves ki queue ka status dikhao.
• Airtable ke 100,000 monthly calls par nazar rakho.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  Kylas logs Enout Super Admin ke naam se banti hain.
🔴 OPEN  Airtable Team plan ki monthly limit ka khatra.
🔴 OPEN  Scale test 2/4 fail: read ki limit table se chhoti ho to bina error ke adhoora data milta hai.
🟢 DONE  Account ka replacing PUT band hai, sirf alag owner endpoint chalta hai.

nodes.name: ✔ Save sahi aur poora hai?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Save ke baad contact Kylas mein badla hua dikhta hai, aur Airtable mein Call Log aur Stage Transition ki row hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: Kaunsi vajah? (D5)
nodes.notes: Placeholder: $json.reason mein wajah aati hai.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Save Kylas tak nahi pahuncha
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Phone number ya field galat ho to Kylas 400 deta hai, aur 5 per second se tez ho to 429. Save D1 queue mein rehta hai aur retry hota hai, par associate ko kuch dikhta nahi.

Pehla kadam:
• Associate ko dikhao ki save queue mein hai ya fail hua.
• Fail hone par kaun sa field galat tha, wahi batao.

nodes.name: 🟡 DECISION · Log Super Admin ke naam
nodes.notes:
🟡 DECISION
Kyun: Console se bana har Kylas log API key ke user (Enout Super Admin) ka hota hai. Dialler ke logs mein ye samasya nahi hai.

Pehla kadam:
• Har associate ki apni key, ya
• note mein naam likhna, ya
• owner field mein associate.

nodes.name: S6 · Background jobs
nodes.notes: har ghante, raat, hafta

parameters.content:
## Step 6 · Background jobs
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Har ghante: dialler ke calls aur Kylas contacts ka naya hissa (stage badlaav yahin Stage Transition bante hain).
• Har minute: D1 copy aur fail hue saves ka retry.
• Raat: 00:15 IST snapshot, 02:00 sync, 02:45 call-back aur offsite quarter wapas Kylas (100 ka cap). Somvaar 02:30 rollup.

**Kya karna hai**
• Push ka cap hatane ka din tay karo (ek raat ka output padhkar).
• Job health panel banao.
• Lagbhag 36,000 unlinked contact rows par faisla.

**Gaps**
🔴 OPEN  Jobs ka natija sirf wrangler tail mein hai.
🟡 DECISION  Push ka 100 ka cap.
🟡 DECISION  Lagbhag 36,000 contact rows kisi company se linked nahi. Koi row delete nahi hogi jab tak aap haan na kahein.

nodes.name: ✔ Jobs time par chale?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Har job ka aakhri run abhi ka hai, rows aayi hain, error nahi hai. Dashboard par 'Kylas synced' kuch minute purana dikhta hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Job chup-chaap fail ya peeche
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Jobs ka natija sirf log mein jaata hai. Cron fail ho ya Kylas sync ghante bhar peeche ho, dashboard par sirf 'synced 1h ago' dikhta hai aur koi alert nahi aata.

Pehla kadam:
• Job health panel: last run, rows, error.
• Failure aur gap ko email digest mein bhejo.

nodes.name: S7 · Dashboard
nodes.notes: ladder, calls, talk time

parameters.content:
## Step 7 · Dashboard
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Saat rungs, companies ginte hain. Worked aur Picked har period dohrate hain, baaki pehli arrival par.
• Calls dialled ek save hai. Connected stage se tay hota hai. Talk time sirf dialler se.
• Team roster tay karta hai kaun ginti mein hai.

**Kya karna hai**
• SQL ka gate tay karo.
• 'Carried in' ki wajah screen par likho.
• Har rung ki definition ek tap mein.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  SQL ke liye Active Requirement Call Done zaroori hai ya nahi.
🔴 OPEN  117% jaise numbers galti jaise lagte hain.
🔴 OPEN  Kylas ka sync ek ghanta peeche chal sakta hai.
🟢 DONE  Dashboard aur accounts list ab 'Worked' ek hi shabd bolte hain.

nodes.name: ✔ Numbers par bharosa hai?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Console aur server ka version milta hai, aur har rung ka matlab saaf hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: Kaunsi vajah? (D7)
nodes.notes: Placeholder: $json.reason mein wajah aati hai.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Purana console chal raha
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Server naya aur extension purana ho to screen alag dikhti hai aur sahi cheez galat padhi jaati hai. Pichhle hafte teen release purani screen ko lekar sawaal aaye.

Pehla kadam:
• Badge bada karo ya khud reload karwao.
• Release checklist: pehle server, phir extension.

nodes.name: 🟡 DECISION · Rung ka matlab saaf nahi
nodes.notes:
🟡 DECISION
Kyun: Ek rung upar wali se zyada dikhe to galti lagti hai (carried in). SQL ke liye Active Requirement Call Done chahiye ya nahi, ye tay nahi.

Pehla kadam:
• SQL gate par faisla.
• Har rung par definition tooltip.

nodes.name: S8 · Review, RCA, re-assign
nodes.notes: atke contacts, owner badalna

parameters.content:
## Step 8 · Review, RCA, re-assign
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• RCA associate se poochta hai ki contact ek rung par kyun atka.
• Next call date wale accounts 'aaj ke follow-ups' mein aate hain.
• Team panel roster tay karta hai, re-assign queue badalta hai.

**Kya karna hai**
• RCA ki patience (kitne din) tay karo.
• RCA jawabon ko queue se jodo.
• Reasons ke saath description jodo.
• Associate ka hafte ka review view.

**Gaps**
🟡 DECISION  RCA ke din tay nahi (30, 21, 14 ka prastaav pada hai).
🔴 OPEN  RCA ke jawab queue ko nahi badalte.

nodes.name: ✔ Atke ka karan pata hai?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Jo contacts ek rung par patience se zyada ruke hain, unke liye associate ne karan chuna hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: 🟡 DECISION · Atke contacts ka karan nahi
nodes.notes:
🟡 DECISION
Kyun: RCA tab poochta hai jab contact gate ki patience se zyada ek rung par ho. Din tay nahi hue (30, 21, 14 prastaav hain), isliye pata nahi list kab banegi.

Pehla kadam:
• Din tay karo.
• Jawab aane par contact ko queue mein upar ya neeche karo.

nodes.name: Code badalta hai
nodes.notes: Koi bhi fix ya feature jo console ya server ko badalta hai. Ye roz ke chakkar ka hissa nahi hai, par Step 4 aur 5 ko yahin se naya code milta hai.

nodes.name: S9 · Release
nodes.notes: zip se Store, deploy se Worker

parameters.content:
## Step 9 · Release
**Abhi kaise chalta hai**
• Code, tests, version badhana (manifest aur wrangler.toml dono), push.
• Zip Chrome Web Store ko jaata hai. Server alag se npm run deploy se.
• Store ke review ke dauran team Load unpacked se chala sakti hai.

**Kya karna hai**
• Store par hafte mein ek stable version bhejo.
• Release checklist: pehle server, phir extension.
• Privacy policy URL host karke store form mein dalo.
• Purana Airtable token rotate karo.

**Gaps**
🔴 OPEN  Store review atka (1.68.0).
🟡 DECISION  Privacy policy URL abhi tak confirm nahi.
🔴 OPEN  Purana Airtable token chat mein khula aaya tha, rotate karna baaki.
🟡 DECISION  Zero host permission ke liye activeTab aur scripting ka raasta: launcher apne aap nahi dikhega.

nodes.name: ✔ Store ne approve kiya?
nodes.notes:
CHECK: Dashboard mein status 'Published' hai, aur server ka VERSION extension ke version se milta hai.

Placeholder: ok=true ka matlab check pass. Asli check se badlo.

nodes.name: Kaunsi vajah? (D9)
nodes.notes: Placeholder: $json.reason mein wajah aati hai.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Store review atka hai
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: 1.17.1 se 1.67.0 tak 50 se zyada updates ek hi permission list ke saath tez nikle. 1.68.0 pehla tha jiski list badli, aur wahi atka. 1.68.1 purani list ke saath dobara bheja gaya hai.

Pehla kadam:
• Intezaar karo, dobara upload mat karo.
• Hafte mein ek hi release store par bhejo.
• Bahut der ho to One Stop Support form.

nodes.name: 🔴 OPEN · Server aur extension alag
nodes.notes:
🔴 OPEN
Kyun: Extension aage ya server aage ho to purani aur nayi cheezein mil jaati hain, aur galat sawaal uthte hain (jaise purani screen par 'ye fix hona tha').

Pehla kadam:
• Pehle npm run deploy, phir zip upload.
• Chhoti release checklist repo mein rakho.

nodes.name: Live
nodes.notes: Store approve karta hai aur 11 users ko extension apne aap update ho jaati hai. Tab tak team Load unpacked se naya build chala sakti hai.
